2610.13356.title: SWE-Critix: Post-Training Generalist Verifiers for Assessing Coding-Agent Trajectories
2610.13356.paper_summary: Coding agents are increasingly deployed for end-to-end software engineering tasks, where a readily available oracle evaluator that defines the success criteria is often absent. This motivates verifications for coding agents that can reliably judge and explain their behavior. However, verification is non-trivial as coding agents are increasingly capable of solving long-horizon software engineering tasks. Their execution trajectories can be extremely long, containing hundreds of iterative interactions with code repositories and external tools. Existing verifiers either rely on general-purpose LLMs without specialized training or train dedicated critics that predominantly focus on producing scalar rewards, highlighting the relatively limited exploration of training-based generalist verification. We introduce SWE-Critix, a post-training pipeline for training generalist verifiers of coding-agent trajectories. Given a task and its execution trajectory, the learned verifier predicts the completion label and generates a natural-language analysis that explains its judgment. Our pipeline combines supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with reinforcement learning (RL) and trains a series of 30B models on trajectories from CodeForge-Preview. On a held-out test set, SWE-Critix improves classification accuracy from 57% for the base Qwen3-30B-A3B reasoning model to 66% after SFT and 78% after RL. We release our models, datasets, and training code to facilitate further research.
2610.13356.paper_summary_zh: 編碼代理越來越多地被部署於端到端的軟體工程任務中，然而通常缺乏一個可用的 oracle 評估器來定義成功標準。這促使我們對編碼代理進行驗證，以便能夠可靠地判斷和解釋其行為。然而，驗證並非易事，因為編碼代理越來越能夠解決長期的軟體工程任務。它們的執行軌跡可能非常長，包含數百次與代碼庫和外部工具的迭代互動。現有的驗證器要麼依賴於沒有專門訓練的一般性 LLM，要麼訓練專門的評審者，這些評審者主要專注於產生標量獎勵，突顯了基於訓練的一般性驗證探索相對有限。我們介紹了 SWE-Critix，一個用於訓練編碼代理軌跡的一般性驗證器的後訓練管道。給定一個任務及其執行軌跡，學習到的驗證器預測完成標籤並生成自然語言分析來解釋其判斷。我們的管道結合了監督式微調 (SFT) 和強化學習 (RL)，並在來自 CodeForge-Preview 的軌跡上訓練了一系列 30B 模型。在一個保留的測試集上，SWE-Critix 將基礎 Qwen3-30B-A3B 推理模型的分類準確率從 57% 提高到 SFT 後的 66% 和 RL 後的 78%。我們釋出我們的模型、數據集和訓練代碼，以促進進一步的研究。
2610.13356.author: Jiajun Hu et.al.
